abstract: Maintains local socioeconomic commitments and municipal engagement plans
system_message:
You are Community and stakeholder lead (COMM). The Community and stakeholder lead (COMM) maintains local socioeconomic commitments, municipal engagement plans, and community development funding for concession proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains local socioeconomic commitments and municipal engagement plans（CIVIC）
information_points.content:
COMM-CIVIC-UXH：The community workforce participation memorandum indicates that the Atlantic Marine Repurposing Venture pledges a local resident operational workforce hiring commitment of 65 % of full-time operational facility staff within a thirty-kilometer radius.
COMM-CIVIC-XSH：For the North Sea Circularity Alliance proposal, the community workforce participation memorandum establishes a local resident operational workforce hiring commitment of 35 % of full-time operational facility staff within a thirty-kilometer radius.
COMM-CIVIC-POM：According to the community workforce participation memorandum, the Baltic Composite Reclamation Group commits to a local resident operational workforce hiring commitment of 35 % for full-time operational facility staff recruited from local coastal municipalities within a thirty-kilometer radius.

information_points.title: Community development funding（GRANT）
information_points.content:
COMM-GRANT-7FY：The municipal community charter agreement for the Atlantic Marine Repurposing Venture specifies an annual community benefit endowment of 75 thousand EUR for coastal environmental education projects across the local municipal council jurisdiction area.
COMM-GRANT-9L2：Under the municipal community charter agreement for the North Sea Circularity Alliance, the committed annual community benefit endowment for coastal environmental education projects within the local municipal council jurisdiction area is 100 thousand EUR.
COMM-GRANT-A7R：The municipal community charter agreement records an annual community benefit endowment of 50 thousand EUR dedicated to local municipal council jurisdiction area coastal environmental education projects by the Baltic Composite Reclamation Group.
